rationale: The change revises the object-category scheme and explicitly affects FR-7.2.2, while the Evaluation Target and Phenomenon of Interest remain unchanged. In the baseline, H1-ORR2 depends on the source-required distinction between vulnerable road users and other objects, with revalidation condition H1-RC2 triggered if FR-7.2.2 or the object-category scheme changes. Therefore only H1-ORR2 must be revalidated.
